title: Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Learning through Model Growth
findings: Continual fine-tuning reduced religious stereotypical bias in the baseline LLM (from 80% to 57%). In contrast, the StackLLM model was adversely affected in the religion category, showing less reduction in bias and ending with a higher bias score (70%) compared to the baseline LLM.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured stereotypical bias related to religion by calculating the percentage of times a model assigned a higher pseudo-likelihood to a stereotypical sentence compared to an anti-stereotypical one within the CrowS-Pairs dataset.
